_readme: Copy this file to config/cluster_mappings.json (which is gitignored). Per-cluster priors for the CV tailoring engine, keyed by the CLU_N ids in clusters.json. Every field is optional; missing fields fall back to 'defaults'. These bias the engine, they do not lock its decisions. experience_priority, deprioritise, and project_emphasis use your floor item ids (the 'id' on each base_cv_content item). skills_emphasis uses your master_profile technical_skills pool keys. default_template is full, lean, or plain.

CLU_1.narrative_hint: One sentence framing how to pitch the candidate for this cluster of roles.
CLU_1.note: Optional free-text reminder of the strategy for this cluster.
